name: Akrivis Components and Tools
old_description: We supply hydro-cleaning systems, vapor degreasers, lead forming equipment, wire bonders, DI water systems, and other SMT manufacturing tools.
about:
Akrivis Components and Tools, based in Henderson, Nevada, was established in 2023 as a North American technical sales and support resource for specialized electronics manufacturing equipment. The company was created to bridge the gap between overseas equipment builders and North American manufacturers needing clearer communication, application review, installation, training, and service coordination.

The firm distributes a focused range of process equipment including hydro-cleaning systems, vapor degreasers, lead forming machines, component tinning systems, wire bonders, and thermal/vacuum heating equipment. Specific models offered include the Vapor SUI Mini compact vapor degreaser, the Hydro-clean LDS batch cleaning system, the Automatic Forming Machine APFL for lead forming, and the Semi-Automatic Bonder PW22 for microelectronics assembly. Beyond equipment supply, Akrivis provides application review, factory coordination, import and delivery logistics, installation and operator training, and post-sale service support from a Los Angeles-area support point covering the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

The company serves electronics manufacturers, labs, and production teams in reliability-critical sectors, primarily aerospace and defense electronics and medical device electronics. Customers typically engage Akrivis when they face specific process challenges such as residue removal, solderability restoration, component geometry control, cleaning workflows, bonding processes, or thermal/vacuum processing steps that require greater repeatability.

Akrivis differentiates itself by adopting an application-first support model that starts with the process requirement rather than a catalog page. The company emphasizes local, U.S.-based communication to overcome time-zone and language barriers, and it coordinates the full purchase scope — including freight, duties, installation, training, documentation, and warranty — before a purchase order is placed. This approach aims to reduce the risk of buying niche equipment directly from overseas builders.
